definition: slowly and smoothly, little by little
description: A big striped hot-air balloon in orange, cream and blue on a grassy field at sunrise. A young woman in a blue jacket stands smiling in the wicker basket as it lifts slowly and smoothly off the ground and rises a little higher. Two people in warm jackets hold ropes and let them out bit by bit, while a black-and-white border collie jumps up at the basket and then runs about on the grass below it. More people and a pickup truck are in the background under a soft pink sky.
